steps.name: traveler of time and space
steps.objective: Go beyond “Hell’s Door” and enter the “world between times” to find someone trapped inside.

steps.name: Siam's Call
steps.objective: After talking to “Siam”, complete the quest from “Liz” at “Wailing Coast”.

lines.text: 『Call of Siam』

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: While I was searching for Iris Livier's whereabouts using search magic, I discovered a strange movement.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I am tied to this world, so I have no choice but to ask you to investigate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: This place where we are now is a place separated from the normal flow of time. It's usually filled with silence and blankness.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It is rare for people who walk the ordinary world of everyday life to visit this place... but sometimes unexpected guests appear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A being with contradictory power whose body is wrapped in scorching heat.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I can't be sure because I'm blind, but the flames were probably the color of pitch black.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It must have been a strange flame that seemed both corrupt and sacred.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: ...In a past battle, when I thought I had finally cornered him, there was a bird of flame that suddenly appeared and became one with the Demon King, giving him strength.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: There is no mistaking that ominous shimmer... It must be something similar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Now it looks like it's hurt. Instead of blood, I felt myself scattering my own power and fluttering through the air of this vast world.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: And then it suddenly disappeared as if erased, and a door suddenly appeared in its place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Perhaps, what lies across from it is a world that has been isolated until now...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Be careful. The only thing emanating from the other side is death and destruction... the smell of darkness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Dazzling light begins to emanate from Siam’s hand.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I will open the door to construction. I hope you find a clue.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: May you keep your pride.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The story has been omitted. Move to the unknown land of Vanaheim.)
『Coast of Wailing』

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The place we arrived at thanks to Siam's magic is a coastline with a strange feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's a lonely-looking scene. It feels somewhat foreign...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have a strange feeling... I feel like someone is pretending to be popular.)

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Is there anyone there? Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A woman's voice is heard from somewhere...!)

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Ah... were you trying to answer now?

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Seeing as how you can't properly respond to message magic, I guess you're not a wizard of the Infinite Corridor.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Do you need any help? I'm sorry, but I don't have the energy to go help right now.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: If you move a little bit to the other side of the sea from where you are now, there is a huge tower. It's safe up there.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: The road is rough so be careful. If you are not confident in your skills... I pray that you have the means to return.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Well then... good luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The presence disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The story has been omitted.

steps.name: Tower of Collapse
steps.objective: Talk to “Jade” on the 3rd floor of “Tower of Collapse” and complete the quest.

lines.text: 『Tower of Collapse』

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: As I said, to conclude, Einst’s intuition is correct.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Let me explain what I have researched so far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Ah... that's Einst's special ability. I heard that it is a power that blooms rarely among the Storm Watchers. It is a special cognitive ability that penetrates the truth of things.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: In a small way, I heard that it is the power to see through lies or to naturally realize the correct process to achieve the future you want.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: That's all I know, the details are a secret among the Storm Watchers... There is also talk of it being an even more amazing ability.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: With the help of Belpa's shaman, I interpreted the literature found in the tower. It has a lot in common with the language of the Gendia continent.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It is believed that this land was once part of the continent of Gyendia.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Its name is "Banaheim"

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It was written that it was a land where the children of spirits and goddesses lived together.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The goddess... is probably the story of the moon goddess who, at a time when the gods abandoned the world, pitied humans alone and fought against the demon king before disappearing.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Its name is Ceres, Der, Arapea... There are many theories.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Judging from the name, I think the name of the people who lived here is 'Der'.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: This tower...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...It's some kind of giant artifact. No normal wizard could create something like this. You shouldn't make it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jade pauses for a moment with a stern expression, then sighs and smiles apologetically.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Sorry. I guess I got a little excited. Let's continue the story.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: This... if the story about the Der tribe is true to legend, it has an unimaginably terrible and evil purpose.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: This tower can be said to be a kind of 'furnace'. And the ingredients inside...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jade hesitates for a moment and then continues.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...It's life.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: When this tower operates, all living beings within it lose their bodies and only their souls are extracted.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Those who did not have the strength to resist or withstand it would have been shattered and died.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: How could you do such a scary thing...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...What it was trying to do with that life force... is unclear.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: However, I wonder if this was Der's last card to fight the "Demon King"... That's what I think.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: On earth...what did the Der people do here?

choices.text: 4. Creatures of darkness and the girl’s soul

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: What happened to the Der people who abandoned their bodies due to the magic of this tower is currently a mystery, but it seems that their bodies were abandoned here.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Couldn't those strange and terrible creatures be the result of it being eroded by creatures of darkness?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: As you can see from the outside, this area is now completely dark. Land, water, creatures, and even wind... The bodies of the Der people left in this tower must have been the same.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Isn't the owner of this terrifying dark power... the legendary demon lord, "Beast"?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: In other words, the Der tribe fought the demon king here using some scary means. As a result, the Der people were destroyed, and this land was permanently polluted...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The girl's "broken soul" is a fragment of the soul that was sacrificed in the process, and what those eyes are looking at is not us, but the appearance of the devil in our nightmares...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: … It's just a guess, but it seems like an overly dark story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jade makes a sad expression.)

choices.text: 5. About the bottom floor of the tower

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I can feel the energy of a huge spirit at the lowest level of the tower.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It makes no sense to use such a huge tower as a magical weapon. It would be impossible unless it were something like the legendary Pluton Dragon.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Perhaps a being with power comparable to the Spirit King helped the Der people. And he is still trapped in the basement of the tower.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: If it helped the Der people, its nature would not be evil... but what is waiting below now has become a host of darkness, constantly spraying the energy of death into the tower.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I can vaguely feel something like the nature of a spirit... but it must have suffered through a difficult time. Fighting and defeating them will help you.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I will organize this story and tell it to Einst. %s. I would like to ask you for an important task.

steps.name: One trapped in the abyss
steps.objective: Defeat Njord on the lowest floor of the “Tower of Collapse” and report to [Jade] on the 3rd floor of the Tower of Collapse.

steps.name: land of beginning
steps.objective: Go up to the “top floor of the Tower of Collapse” and talk to “Jade”, then talk to the “Wizard” at the “entrance to the Tower of Collapse”.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...This scene...?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A huge magical whirlpool is in front of you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A vortex large enough to sweep away the surroundings quietly circles in place in an incomprehensible silence.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: That thing floating around the whirlpool... Could that huge thing be a magic artifact?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: And no way...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At first glance, it seems like a shadow can be seen inside the vortex.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...have you ever seen it? There seems to be something inside.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...island...?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: No way... It's a different story from Freios, who took his current form as a result of being toyed with by mythical beings. It is impossible to float such a huge structure using artificial magic...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...No, it's a rumor. At this moment, this place is already the realm of myth.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...I'm getting scared again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jade's expression shows enthusiasm and a little joy despite what she is saying.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jade looks around and nods.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: In the literature, it was written, “To go ‘above,’ go to the top of the tower and step on the stairs of light.”

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I wondered what the story was about, but at least it became clear where ‘up’ was.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The stairs aren't difficult. If you reconstruct the magic circle around here and activate it, you will be able to go up to that place.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Please wait a moment. I will quickly restore the transfer magic.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Why did the Der abandon their bodies, where did their souls go, what exactly happened... !

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...I hope the answer is up there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I decided to leave this place to Jade and go back first.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The last time I looked at the sky, I think I saw something like a feather transparently melting into the air.)
